title_ar: وفد من علماء الأمة يزور مفتي عمان العلامة أحمد الخليلي
title_en: A Delegation of the Ummah's Scholars Visits the Mufti of Oman, the Learned Ahmad al-Khalili
body_ar:
أدى وفد من علماء الأمة صباح اليوم السبت 05 نوفمبر 2022م زيارة اطمئنان لفضيلة العلامة الشيخ أحمد الخليلي مفتي دولة عُمان ونائب رئيس الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين.

ويتكون الوفد من أصحاب الفضيلة الشيخ علي القرداغي والشيخ علي الصلابي والشيخ محمد الحسن الددو حفظهم الله أجمعين.

وتطرق الحديث إلى قضايا الأمة، وأوضاع الشعوب المسلمة، ودور العلماء في نصرة الحق، ورفع الظلم عن المظلومين.

واستقبل فضيلتُه الوفد الكريم ببيته العامر بالعاصمة العُمانية مسقط.
وبعد اللقاء تجول الوفد الزائر في مكتبة العلامة الخليلي، واطلع على ماتضمنته من نفائس الكتب والمخطوطات القيمة.

وقد عبر أعضاء الوفد عن تقديرهم ومحبتهم وإعجابهم بفضيلة العلامة أحمد الخليلي الذي عرف بمواقفه المشرفة نصرة للأمة وقضاياها العادلة.
body_en:
On the morning of today, Saturday 5 November 2022, a delegation of the Ummah's scholars paid a visit to enquire after the wellbeing of His Eminence the learned Sheikh Ahmad al-Khalili, Mufti of the State of Oman and deputy president of the International Union of Muslim Scholars.

The delegation consists of their Eminences Sheikh Ali al-Qaradaghi, Sheikh Ali al-Sallabi and Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, may God preserve them all.

The conversation ranged over the concerns of the Ummah, the circumstances of the Muslim peoples, and the role of the scholars in coming to the aid of the truth and lifting injustice from those who are wronged.

His Eminence received the honoured delegation at his home in the Omani capital, Muscat.
After the meeting the visiting delegation walked through the library of the learned al-Khalili and looked over the precious books and valuable manuscripts it holds.

The members of the delegation expressed their esteem, their affection and their admiration for His Eminence the learned Ahmad al-Khalili, who is known for his honourable stands in coming to the aid of the Ummah and its just causes.

flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW, lower exposure than records 1103 or 1340 but real. The report names Ali al-Qaradaghi and Ali al-Sallabi as members of the delegation and identifies the host as deputy president of the International Union of Muslim Scholars. The Union, and both named scholars, were designated as a terrorist organisation and as designated individuals by Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Egypt and Bahrain in 2017. Those are Gulf-state designations, not Western ones: the Union is not proscribed in the United Kingdom, the European Union or the United States, so the exposure here is reputational rather than legal in Western jurisdictions, and lower than in the records flagged above. Nothing in the item is more than a report of a visit to enquire after an elderly scholar's health, and it has been translated exactly as it stands. Flagged so that the naming is a conscious editorial decision rather than a default (style guide section 12). Record 1103 in this corpus carries the same organisation at much higher exposure.

translator_notes: A news report by the site's news desk. Nothing in it is attributed to Sheikh al-Dedew in his own words.

زيارة اطمئنان is a visit made to satisfy oneself that someone is well, typically after illness; 'a visit to enquire after his wellbeing' carries that, where a bare 'courtesy visit' would lose the reason for it.

The CMS timestamp is 6 November; the body reports 'today, Saturday 5 November'. The report has been dated by its CMS stamp, as elsewhere in the corpus, and the discrepancy is noted rather than corrected.

Raised for editorial review on account of the organisation and the individuals named, not on account of anything asserted in the report, which is a routine courtesy visit. Recorded at the lower end of the scale, with the designating states named precisely so the reviewer is not left to infer a Western proscription that does not exist.
